# Slay Kallio — Concept Pack v0.2

v0.2 reframes the project around a **low-frame cardboard standee system**.

## Main change from v0.1

Slay Kallio does not need to rebuild the TURF cast into full side-view animation sets.

The existing front and front-3/4 TURF concepts can be printed directly onto upright cardboard pieces with rounded upper edges and a flat bottom. Characters move left and right as physical standees while largely keeping the same artwork.

This lets the project reuse a much larger share of the existing TURF visual library and reduces animation production radically.

## Default movement

One standing art state can handle normal travel through:

- horizontal translation
- subtle vertical bob
- small forward/back tilt
- acceleration lean
- stop wobble
- brief edge-on flip where useful

No conventional walk cycle is required by default.

## New art only when needed

Target per-character minimum:

- 1 default standing/front art
- 2–3 attack states
- 1 hit/recoil state
- 1 KO/fall state

Add more only when gameplay readability or character personality clearly benefits.

## Material language

The character should read as a real printed cardboard game piece:

- matte printed surface
- rounded top/sides or silhouette-following upper edge
- flat bottom edge
- visible thin card thickness at turns/falls
- fibrous/scuffed physical edge
- contact shadow generated by the world, never baked into art

## Source hierarchy

1. Front/front-3/4 TURF concepts — primary standee faces
2. Broad roster sheets — rapid cast population
3. Side/profile sheets — optional actions and special cases
4. Near-profile TURF rejects — useful action candidates
5. Turnarounds — only where directional art is genuinely needed
6. Clothing/prop sheets — variants and action replacements

See `../../ART_REQUEST.md` for the full production brief.
